answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring a refundable stake before an agent may trade, rising steeply for each extra identity from the same operator. Treat the stake like an opal: valuable, verifiable, and costly to duplicate at scale. New agents start with whisper-quiet permissions — tiny trades only — and only honest, attested work unlocks larger deals. Reaching the summit of full rights takes weeks of behavior, so ten thousand fake identities means ten thousand locked deposits and ten thousand probation periods. Faking identity costs more than gaming the market pays.
